description: Main source code for a Bluetooth audio sink player that streams WAV files over Bluetooth, including thread management, Bluetooth sink state handling, and file I/O.

classes.name: context_t
classes.description: Holds context information for Bluetooth audio streaming session, including file path, connection state, thread handle, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: wav_header_t
classes.description: Represents the WAV file header structure used to parse WAV file format details.

methods.name: playback_task
methods.description: Thread function that manages WAV file streaming over Bluetooth, handling configuration, file reading, and frame sending.

methods.name: audio_sink_disconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when Bluetooth sink disconnects.

methods.name: audio_sink_connected
methods.description: Handles actions upon Bluetooth sink connection.

methods.name: audio_sink_state_changed
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth sink state changes, managing connection and streaming states.

methods.name: audio_sink_operational_state_update
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth sink operational state updates, registering or handling sink availability.

methods.name: ctrl_c_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to set user_break flag for graceful termination.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main program entry that initializes Bluetooth sink, parses WAV file, manages connection, and starts playback thread.
